versions.changelog:
Initial release of chengyu-card-poster: an automatic generator for Xiaohongshu Chéngyǔ card captions.

- Input a chéngyǔ and get a Xiaohongshu-style post (~500 characters) ready to publish.
- Randomizes title style and increment content type for creative variety.
- Generates parent-friendly extra information that's not on standard chéngyǔ cards.
- Adds an open-ended question to drive interaction in comments or at home.
- Outputs formatted markdown files with post content and required tags.
- Interactive: Displays output and asks if you'd like a different version.
